question: A single discount equivalent to three successive discounts of 10%, 5% and 3(1)/(2)% will be ______.
solution:
**Given:**

Successive discounts = 10%, 5%, 3.5%

**Concept:**

Successive discounts can be computed using the formula: net discount = 1 - (1 - d1) × (1 - d2) × ...

**Solution:**

⇒ Net discount = 1 - (1 - 0.1) × (1 - 0.05) × (1 - 0.035)

⇒ Net discount = 1 - 0.9 × 0.95 × 0.965 = 0.174925

**Hence, a single discount equivalent to the three successive discounts is 0.174925 or 17.4925%**
